desc:
There are n couples and 2n seats in a single row, numbered 0..2n-1. The people are numbered 0..2n-1 and couple k consists of persons 2k and 2k + 1. row[i] is the person sitting in seat i.

In one move any two people may exchange seats. Return the minimum number of moves after which every couple sits in two neighbouring seats (2j, 2j + 1) (in either order).

Example: row = [0, 2, 1, 3] returns 1: swap persons 2 and 1.
hints: Look at the seat pairs (0,1), (2,3), ... one by one from the left. Once a pair is settled you never need to touch it again.
If seat 0 holds person x, the partner of x is x ^ 1. Putting that partner into seat 1 costs at most one swap, and it is never worse than any other choice for that pair.

Keep an array pos[person] with the current seat of everyone, so each swap and each lookup is O(1). Process seat pairs from left to right and count the swaps. (Equivalent view: connect two couples when they share a seat pair; the answer is the sum of size - 1 over the connected groups.)
editorial: Take the first seat pair. If it is not already a couple, the person in seat 0 must end up next to their partner and the person in seat 1 does not belong to them. Swapping the partner into seat 1 fixes this pair with one move, and that move also ends up being part of an optimal solution: there is always an optimal solution with this move because any solution has to bring the partner of the person in seat 0 next to him, and swapping a different person into seat 1 can only be worse or equal.

Therefore a greedy sweep from left to right is optimal. For pair (2j, 2j+1) let x = row[2j]; the partner is x ^ 1. If row[2j + 1] is not the partner, swap row[2j + 1] with the partner at pos[x ^ 1], update pos for both people and add one to the answer.

Graph view: make a node for every seat pair and an edge between the two pairs that hold the two members of each couple. The graph is a union of cycles, and a cycle with c pairs needs c - 1 swaps, which gives the same total. The sweep needs O(n) time and O(n) space for pos.
solution:
def minSwapsCouples(row):
    row = list(row)
    pos = [0] * len(row)
    for i, x in enumerate(row):
        pos[x] = i
    swaps = 0
    for i in range(0, len(row), 2):
        partner = row[i] ^ 1
        if row[i + 1] != partner:
            j = pos[partner]
            other = row[i + 1]
            row[i + 1], row[j] = partner, other
            pos[partner] = i + 1
            pos[other] = j
            swaps += 1
    return swaps
